descripcion: At B1 you connect ideas with simple markers: and, but, so, because. These are the basic building blocks that later grow into the fuller set used at B2 and C1, where register and nuance start to matter.

ejemplos.texto: I like the city, but it's very noisy.
I was tired, so I went to bed early.
I stayed home because it was raining.

notas: So gives the result, because gives the reason — these are opposite and often confused.
Also can start a sentence, but it's a bit more formal than and.
Using too many connectors in a row makes a sentence hard to follow.

contraste.es: El español conecta ideas de forma parecida con y, pero, porque, así que, así que estos conectores básicos se transfieren directamente.

errores: Using and repeatedly instead of a more precise connector.
Stacking too many connectors in one sentence.
autochequeo: Have I used so for result and because for reason correctly?
Have I used at least three different connectors?
Is any sentence overloaded with too many connectors?
promptCorreccion: Focus only on basic discourse markers. Check the difference between so and because, and flag any sentence overloaded with too many connectors. Do not rewrite the text.
